Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

Ten offers is not a strategy. It's quitting, spread across ten tabs.

Adding a second offer before the first one converts feels like progress and costs nothing emotionally — which is exactly why people do it. But it's the same beginner's week run again with a fresh tab open.

The rule: one offer, one angle, one format, until it works. You cannot read a signal from three experiments running at once.

You're allowed to add a second when all three of these are true:

1. The first one converts. Not "gets views" — converts.
2. The format runs itself. You can batch a week in one sitting.
3. You have ninety days of data. Anything shorter is noise.
